label: early copy-phase input of fed-back i
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (never in the original or delimiter phases), and almost entirely at steps where the fed-back input is the letter i (86% of activation mass); the remainder is on h, x, l inputs. Activity is concentrated in the first few copy steps (recall_idx 1-3 hold ~97% of mass; peaks at recall_idx 2, i.e. i was original token 1, as in a i ... <DEL> a [i]). Never fires on the first occurrence of a token. Magnitude is higher when the token being output next is one of x, l, h, i, m (in_tok i plus out_tok in that set raises precision to ~0.56 but drops mass recall to 0.63). Precision of the main predicate is low (~0.19): many early-copy i inputs followed by other tokens do not fire, so the description is incomplete.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=i (+7.77), phase=2 & in_tok=x (+6.45), phase=2 & out_tok=x (+5.64), phase=2 & in_tok=l (+5.25), phase=2 & out_tok=h (+5.08), phase=2 & out_tok=l (+4.95). Lower it: recall_idx=5 (-2.67), orig_idx=-1 (-2.35), orig4=- (-2.15), in_first=0 (-1.97).
